name: A11 MCP Connectivity
description: Vérifie la connectivité MCP public après modification de config MCP

then.command: powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://mcp.funesterie.me/health' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host \"MCP Public: $($r.ok)\" } catch { Write-Host \"MCP Public: DOWN\" }"
